dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: 49ers (9-1) Week 12 Briefing: Pass-Rush Review & Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Seahawks
bullets: Roster & Front Office: San Francisco signed WR Brandin Cooks to the practice squad [Eric Branch](https://x.com/Eric_Branch/status/2125667218663047562).

Injury & Practice Status: San Francisco opened OT Austen Pleasants's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for CB Upton Stout (shoulder, neck), OT Carver Willis (illness), and CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) [Jennifer Lee Chan](https://bsky.app/profile/jenniferleechan.bsky.social/post/3n363ffuxrc2k). WR Jordan Watkins (groin), S Siran Neal (knee, foot), QB Brock Purdy (ankle), and WR Mike Evans (Achilles) did not practice Wednesday, while DE Khalid Kareem (ankle) and DE Mykel Williams (hand) practiced in full.

Week 12 Seahawks Outlook: Kyle Shanahan and DC Raheem Morris open installation for the Seattle Seahawks (6-4, SF -2.5, HC Mike Macdonald, OC Brian Fleury & DC Aden Durde (Levi's Stadium)) at high altitude in Mexico City—a unit ranked #1 in Yards Allowed / Game (236.1 yds) as San Francisco prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Tim Kawakami](https://bsky.app/profile/timkawakami.bsky.social/post/3n36jzvozwk2v) [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/49ers-activate-cb-nate-hobbs-sign-wr-brandin-cooks-to-practice-squad).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 9-1 (1st in NFC West • #1 Seed in NFC), San Francisco carries a 99.5% postseason projection, 91.5% NFC West division title mark, and 63.7% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-puka-nacua-sam-darnold-49ers-rams-seahawks/).
